01 · Overview

Why SELLO Lite?

The challenge

Small food and retail businesses often deal with unreliable internet, yet most POS apps stop working the moment connectivity drops — blocking checkout at the worst possible time.

The SELLO Lite solution

SELLO Lite treats offline as the default. Every sale, product and receipt is stored on the device, so the till keeps working through outages, and the owner backs up the data on their own terms.

Built for

  • Restaurants and cafés selling dishes in several portion sizes
  • Small shops that want a simple till without a cloud subscription
  • Businesses where internet is unreliable or costly
  • Owners who want sales data on their own device

What you get

  • Keeps taking sales through internet outages
  • One-time device activation (1, 2 or 5-year plans) — no recurring per-seat billing
  • Sales data stays on the device you control
  • English, Spanish, French, Hindi and Arabic, with right-to-left layout

Licensing

7-day free trial

Every install starts with a full 7-day free trial — no card needed.

One-time activation

An activation code tied to the device unlocks a 1, 2 or 5-year plan — no monthly subscription and no per-seat billing.

03 · Capabilities

Key features

Portions per item

Quarter / half / full for a dish, or small / medium / large for a drink — each with its own price.

Split payments

Cash, card, bank transfer, QR, mobile wallet or store credit in a single sale.

Hold & resume carts

An interrupted order never has to be re-entered from scratch.

Receipts that fit

Print or share receipts sized for A4 or 80 / 78 / 58 mm thermal rolls, with your logo.

Sales reports

Day, week, month, year or custom range, with payment and tax breakdowns and best-sellers — export to CSV or PDF.

One-tap backup

Export your own copy of the sales database at any time.

How it works

  1. Set up the catalogue once: products, categories, tax rates and portion sizes.
  2. Ring up sales from the till screen, holding a cart mid-order and resuming it later.
  3. Take payment — split across several methods if needed.
  4. Print or share the receipt, sized for your printer or paper.
  5. Check performance in Reports and export any period as CSV or PDF.

Technical details

Under the hood

Technology

React Native (Expo) app for Android with a local SQLite database as the system of record. Schema changes ship as additive, versioned migrations, so updates never drop existing data. Receipts and reports are generated on the device, and backups are a point-in-time copy of the database file.

Your data

All business, product and sales data is stored on the device. Nothing is sent to Anqah Tech or any third party; backups are exported only when the owner chooses to.

Frequently asked questions

Does it need an internet connection?

No. Sales, receipts and reports all work fully offline.

What happens to my data when I update?

Nothing is lost. Database changes are additive-only, so updates keep everything already on the device.

How does licensing work?

Every install starts with a 7-day free trial. After that, a one-time activation code tied to the device unlocks a 1, 2 or 5-year plan — no subscription.
